steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: A tort is a civil wrong — the claimant sues the defendant for compensation, unlike criminal law where the state prosecutes

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Negligence is the most common tort — it requires duty of care, breach of that duty, causation and resulting damage

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Duty of care exists where the defendant owed a legal duty to the claimant — established by the Caparo three-stage test

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Caparo test requires: (1) foreseeability of harm, (2) proximity of relationship and (3) it is fair, just and reasonable to impose a duty

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always work through the four elements of negligence in order — duty, breach, causation, damage The Caparo test is essential for duty of care — explain each of the three stages Use the reasonable person test when discussing breach — it is an objective standard Contributory negligence is a common exam topic — know it reduces damages rather than eliminating them Vicarious liability is frequently tested — know the 'course of employment' requirement
